column1: # Babi's Palace: every story state, resident, examination and Mind Read entry.

column3: Have you seen Babi's\nsoldiers? They were\nsearching every street.{end_now}

I should be fighting!
Not sitting here
with this bad back.{page_break}I trained for months.
Next year, perhaps.{end_wait}
Three dinners before\ntraining. No wonder\nmy stomach hurts!{end_wait}

If you're entering
Colosso, hurry!{page_break}The trials won't wait
for anyone.
Not even you.{end_wait}

The finest fighters
may join Babi's guard.{page_break}Not a bad living,
if you don't mind
the discipline.{end_wait}

{actor_name:7} is why
Lalivero's builders
must obey Babi.{page_break}Everyone knows it.
No one wants to
say it aloud.{end_wait}
The finals are near!\nGet to the arena!{end_wait}
You came here to recover\nbefore your next match,\ndidn't you?{page_break}Will you sleep now?{end_now}
Babi's back!\nThe finals can begin.\nThank goodness.{end_wait}

{actor_name:7} smiled today.
I hadn't seen that
since she arrived.{page_break}The soldiers say
she may go home.
I hope it's true.{end_wait}

The guards spoke
to {actor_name:7} today.
She seems calmer.{page_break}I don't know what
they promised her.
Will they keep it?{end_wait}

Lord Babi is safe.
The palace can finally
settle down.{page_break}But the guards who
searched for him
need a good rest.{end_wait}
You crossed the Karagol\nfrom the eastern shore?\nDo you miss home already?{end_now}
Colosso is finished.\nI'm bound for Gondowan\nto raise Babi's lighthouse.{end_wait}

Gondowan is dangerous.
The roads are rough.
Watch your step.{page_break}I've been there once.
Still have the scars.{end_wait}

Babi's skin has gone
white as old stone. He
looks almost like a corpse.{page_break}No one will speak of it.
Perhaps they fear what
he might do if they did.{end_wait}
The Cloak Ball is\nnow yours.{end_wait}

The girl from Lalivero
has left the palace.
Guards took her home.{page_break}We should have
sent her back
long ago.{end_wait}

{actor_name:7} was allowed
to go back home.
At last.{page_break}I hope her family
is waiting for her.
She deserves that.{end_wait}

Only Colosso entrants
may enter the palace.{page_break}And no wandering
into private rooms.
I've enough to do.{end_wait}

Some rooms are open to
Colosso entrants. Lord
Babi has allowed it.{page_break}Try to remember whose
roof you're standing
under.{end_wait}
You may use the four\nbeds. Will you sleep\nnow?{end_now}
If you need to rest,\nplease do. The next match\nwill come soon enough.{end_wait}
Are you entering\nColosso?{end_now}
I can't fight over a\nbit of stomach pain?\nWhat a miserable excuse.{end_wait}

Even if I escaped,
how could I cross
the Suhalla alone?{page_break}Lalivero is so far.
But I have to
find a way home.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}! Wake up!{page_break}Come on, {actor_name:1}!\nYou have to get up!{end_wait}
Would you like\nto sleep now?{end_now}
I've been waiting for\nyou and your companions,\n{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
You're {actor_name:1},\naren't you?{end_now}

{actor_name:1}, I owe you
for bringing Babi back.
He wants to see you.{page_break}He's waiting at the
colosseum. Don't keep
him there.{end_wait}
Babi is waiting at the\ncolosseum. Go straight\nthere, as he requested.{end_wait}
The warriors who stayed\nhere have all left now.\nWill you be leaving too?{end_now}
The water is clear.\nNothing has disturbed it.{end_wait}
Are Babi's soldiers still\nsearching? I sent them\nthrough every quarter.{end_wait}
If you won't enter the\nColosso, you cannot stay\nin the palace. Leave.{end_wait}

I'd rather be watching
the matches. Instead, I
must cheer the fighters on.{page_break}A fine duty, they say.
I would trade it for
a place in the arena.{end_wait}
The lighthouse is Babi's\nmonument to himself.\nThat's how I see it.{end_wait}

Every stone must fit.
That's Babi's order.{page_break}And every worker
knows the guards
are watching.{end_wait}

Even if Babi never
returns, the work will
continue.{page_break}I only hope we learn
what happened to him
before it is too late.{end_wait}

My first Colosso!
I still remember
that roar.{page_break}Even now I get
excited when the
finals begin.{end_wait}
When the lighthouse is\nfinished, Babi's name\nwill outlive us all.{end_wait}
I would never reach the\nworksite without Iodem's\npasses.{end_wait}
They say the girl is\ngoing with the next\nparty to Gondowan.{end_wait}

Babi's bed was untouched
this morning. He never
misses his routine.{page_break}Something has changed.
No one wants to say
what it is.{end_wait}
He did not sleep here\nlast night. I heard the\nguards moving before dawn.{end_wait}

{actor_name:7} came from
Lalivero, far south
of here.{page_break}Babi calls her
a guest. But she
cannot leave.{end_wait}

Lalivero calls
{actor_name:7} a child
of the gods.{page_break}I see a girl who
misses her family.
Why won't they listen?{end_wait}

I'm not Babi's guest.
He keeps me here so
Lalivero will build.{page_break}I've asked to go home.
He won't listen.
But I'll keep asking.{end_wait}

{actor_name:7} cannot leave.
That's Babi's order.{page_break}She's far from home.
I wonder how her
family bears it.{end_wait}
This armor is battered.\nIt must have belonged\nto a Colosso fighter.{end_wait}

The room is dark.
Only a few old dice
lie scattered inside.{page_break}Someone spent a long
time here, and lost
more than a game.{end_wait}
A headband. Its words\nare nearly worn away:\nHold fast until the bell.{end_wait}

A book titled The
Fighter's Discipline.{page_break}Its advice is simple:
Fight hard. Leave your
money out of the wagers.{end_wait}

A ledger of dice games.
The same name appears
again and again.{page_break}The sums beside it
are all losses.{end_wait}

A book: Become Strong
in Twelve Easy Steps.{page_break}The pages are full of
exercises and promises.
Most are underlined.{end_wait}
Babi's diary. The last\nentry is brief:{page_break}"I do not know if I\nwill see another year."{end_wait}

Babi's soldiers are
watching Colosso now.
They are fighters too.{page_break}They cheer with the rest,
but their eyes keep
turning toward the exits.{end_wait}

Those fighters look
ready for anything.
I wonder if they are.{page_break}Confidence is easy
when the crowd is
shouting your name.{end_wait}

The finals are here!
I hope we see
a fine match.{page_break}And no injuries.
I've seen enough
of those.{end_wait}
Good luck out there!\nCome back safely.{end_wait}

Babi came back and
went straight out.
He barely sat down.{page_break}I wish he'd rest.
Even Babi needs sleep.{end_wait}
I wish Colosso\nwould end already.\nI'm tired of waiting.{end_wait}

Seeing {actor_name:7} smile
was a relief.{page_break}She's waited long
enough to see
her family again.{end_wait}
{actor_name:7} is polite.\nBut she knows what\nshe wants.{end_wait}
They say I can\nreturn to Lalivero\nafter Colosso.{end_wait}

I hardly see Babi now.
Sometimes I think he is
afraid to be alone.{page_break}What could frighten a
man who commands this
whole city?{end_wait}

It would be a shame to
let you leave, {actor_name:1}.
I won't tell you the way.{page_break}You have earned no
favors from me.{end_wait}

No more fighters
sleeping here until
next year's Colosso.{page_break}But I'll keep the
beds ready. That's
my job, after all.{end_wait}

If I left this room
untouched, it would fill
with dust.{page_break}I suppose I should keep
cleaning. It gives me
something to do.{end_wait}
I hoped I would be the\none to find Babi. The\nsearch is over now.{end_wait}

Colosso is over. We must
return to the lighthouse
and finish the work.{page_break}{pause_20_skippable}I still wonder why Babi
needs it completed
so urgently.{end_wait}
If the lighthouse\nis finished, perhaps\nI can go home.{end_wait}

The Cloak Ball hides you
from the eyes of beasts
when you stand in shadow.{page_break}That is how I crossed
Altmiller Cave without
being seen.{end_wait}
Why would an Adept need\na Cloak Ball, {actor_name:1}?\nYou have other gifts.{end_wait}

The draught is nearly
gone. I can feel
my strength fading.{page_break}If you reach Lemuria,
bring back more.
I need more time.{end_wait}

I wish we had met sooner,
{actor_name:1}. Perhaps
things might differ.{page_break}But some roads close
long before we see
where they lead.{end_wait}

If Babi dies, what becomes
of Tolbi? No one speaks
of what follows him.{page_break}I fear the answer is
that nothing here will
change for the better.{end_wait}

{actor_name:7} went home.
That should never
have been in doubt.{page_break}Who decided her
future for her?
No one told me.{end_wait}
Should the palace be\nopen to visitors while\nBabi is missing?{end_wait}
How many people will\nstay here after Colosso?\nWill anyone remain?{end_wait}

Babi wants you at the
colosseum. Go there
without delay.{page_break}He does not want you
wandering through the
palace first.{end_wait}
They brought Babi back,\nbut that does not make\nthem fit for the finals.{end_wait}

Since Colosso ended, the
city has gone quiet.
I miss the crowds.{page_break}I never thought I would
miss the sound of people
cheering for blood.{end_wait}
The end of a festival\nleaves the streets empty.\nIt is a lonely silence.{end_wait}

The best fighters should
stay in Tolbi. That is
why Babi holds Colosso.{page_break}He gathers strong people
under one roof. What he
plans for them is unclear.{end_wait}
{protagonist_name} peered\ninto the well...{page_break}
